subject: Clarifying DPA incident scope & expedited evidence requests for Finera cross-border triage
messages:
From: Samantha Ortega <samantha.ortega@finera.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finera.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Potential data exposure — request to trigger DPA notify & evidence handoff

Mina —

Thanks for taking this urgently. We detected unusual access to a development dataset that contains hashed customer identifiers and a small subset of contact emails. At this stage our security team classifies this as a limited exposure but we need to follow the DPA notification clauses for EU customers.

Can you confirm Redwood’s expected timelines for:
- Initial acknowledgement and triage window
- Time-to-deliver forensic snapshot / collection artifacts
- Subprocessor involvement and whether Redwood will provide an export compatible with our forensic team

We have basic logs and a short incident summary attached. Finera would like the tech/ops liaison and a legal contact who can coordinate evidence transfer and confirm whether the expedited 48/72h notification path applies based on the contract wording.

Samantha Ortega
Head of Security Operations
Finera Health
Attachments: finera_incident_summary.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortega <samantha.ortega@finera.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Potential data exposure — request to trigger DPA notify & evidence handoff

Samantha —

Thanks for the heads-up and the summary. We’ll treat this as a priority. Quick answers up front, then a short plan: 

Short answers:
- Acknowledgement: within 2 hours of this thread for triage kickoff (we’ve started).
- Initial triage window: 24 hours for a scoped preliminary report (what we call our "prelim snapshot").
- Forensic artifacts: depending on scope, we can produce a read-only forensic snapshot and relevant logs within 48–96 hours. If this qualifies for an expedited pathway under your DPA clause, we’ll compress to 48 hours.
- Subprocessor involvement: we will enumerate any subs (storage, telemetry) and include the mapping. We can provide an export format (CSV + SHA256 manifests) your FS team prefers.

Proposed plan (please confirm):
1) Today — triage call (30m) to align scope, lead contacts, and what Finera needs for the 48/72 assessment. Proposed times: 10:00 UTC or 15:00 UTC.
2) Preliminary snapshot delivered within 24 hours after call.
3) Forensic/export package within 48–96 hours depending on whether forensic capture needs deeper retention pulls.
4) Legal/compliance: Marcus will lead contract/DPA interpretation and confirm whether the DPA’s "material breach" threshold is met for a 48h notify.

I attached a short evidence request template (we use this to surface the exact export artifacts and file formats). Also flagging that if Finera needs a sworn chain-of-custody statement we can include one but that may add another 24 hours.

Mina Haddad
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_subproc_map.csv, finera_evidence_request.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortega <samantha.ortega@finera.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Potential data exposure — request to trigger DPA notify & evidence handoff

Samantha / Mina —

Appreciate the quick signals. A few legal/compliance points from our side:
- Contract read: The DPA sets an "aggravated exposure" threshold tied to the sensitivity of data and likelihood of re-identification. Has Finera’s security flagged any confirmed re-identification risk? If not, we treat this as a notification-path assessment rather than an outright reportable breach.
- Cross-border export: since you’re EU-based, we will follow the DPA export flow. If we need to transfer raw logs outside EU, we will only do so under SCCs or a documented legal basis; we will coordinate with your procurement/legal team and provide the requisite transfer justification.
- Subprocessor assistance: Redwood will coordinate exports that include subprocessor identifiers and hashed manifests. We will not provide raw storage snapshots from third-party vendor consoles without a signed data export authorization.

Action items I can own: 
- Review the DPA clauses cited by Finera and send line-by-line interpretation by EOD tomorrow.
- Share a minimal export template and our chain-of-custody language.
- If Finera requests expedited 48h notification verification, we’ll require a signed evidence transfer form (we can e-sign) and a contact for logistics.

Can we book the triage call at 15:00 UTC today? If that works, I’ll include a brief agenda: scope, affected data categories, subproc map, export format, next steps and ownership.

Marcus Lin
Head of Legal, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachment referenced: request_for_evidence.xlsx (attached by Mina)

From: Samantha Ortega <samantha.ortega@finera.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finera.com
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 13:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Potential data exposure — request to trigger DPA notify & evidence handoff

Mina / Marcus —

15:00 UTC works for us — I’ll send a calendar invite in a moment. Quick clarifications ahead of the call: 
- No confirmed re-identification at this point; security flagged unusual dev access and possible accidental exposure.
- Affected records: approx. 3,600 hashed IDs, ~120 contact emails (partial subset), no clear payment data.
- Preferred export: CSV exports with a SHA256 manifest, plus full access logs for the 7-day window.
- We confirm we can sign your evidence transfer consent form — procurement@finera.com will coordinate DocuSign.

Thanks for the rapid response and for clarifying the cross-border process — Finera legal will be on the call. See you at 15:00 UTC.

Samantha Ortega
Head of Security Operations
Finera Health
Attachments: none
